expected_outcomes: Material work is isolated in short-lived, single-purpose branches.
required_actions: Protect release branches, avoid direct material pushes, and name branches by type, scope, and outcome.
acceptance: Each material branch maps to one mission and a protected base.
verification: Compare the branch, base, issue, and changed paths.
failure_conditions: A protected branch receives an unreviewed material change or a branch mixes missions.
exceptions: Document retained branch purpose and owner.
